U.S. Food and Drug Administration — North America

💡 Did you know: FDA can take up to a year to review a standard new drug application, but a "priority review" voucher — sometimes sold between companies for over $100 million — can cut that to 6 months.

Discovery & Preclinical

Lab and animal studies establish basic safety pharmacology and toxicology before human testing. This sits outside the regulatory clock — length depends on the science, not the agency.
